body:
In the US cities below, Brian will be hosting a ticketed leadership-oriented gathering for clergy and lay leaders in the afternoon, along with a free, open-to-the-public book signing in the evening. For more information and to register, see the tickets and registration links below.

 11/1 Nashville-Franklin, TN. GRACEPOINTE Church

1:00-4:30pm Ticketed workshop with Brian – Tickets *

7:30pm Talk and Book Signing, free and open to the public – Registration requested but not required.

 11/2 Charlotte, NC. Missiongathering Charlotte

1:00-4:30pm Ticketed workshop with Brian Tickets *

7:30pm Talk and Book Signing, free and open to the public. Registration requested but not required.

 11/3 Atlanta-Decatur, GA. First Baptist Church

1:00-4:30pm Ticketed workshop with Brian – Tickets *

7:00pm (note time change for this event only) Talk and Book Signing, free and open to the public – Registration requested but not required.

 11/4 Boston, MA. Old South Church in Boston

1:00-4:30pm Ticketed workshop with Brian Tickets *

 11/4 Newton, MA. First Baptist Church in Newton

7:30pm Talk and Book Signing, free and open to the public – Registration requested but not required.

 11/5 New York, NY. Middle Collegiate Church

1:00-4:30pm Ticketed workshop with Brian Tickets *

 11/5 New York, NY. The Riverside Church

7:30pm Talk and Book Signing, free and open to the public – Registration requested but not required.

 11/6 New York, NY. Forefront Church

10:00am and 11:30am Sunday Service – free and open to the public.

 11/7 Spencerville, MD Cedar Ridge Community Church

1:00-4:30pm Ticketed workshop with Brian – Tickets *

7:30pm Talk and Book Signing, free and open to the public – Registration requested but not required.

*The first 24 tickets purchased for the afternoon event include a gratis copy of Brian’s new book.

Click on the calendar to view more information about the events on Brian’s schedule.

Invite Brian to speak by contacting laci.scott@gmail.com. This email is for booking purposes only. If you have a question or comment for Brian, please direct those to info@/archive/brian-mclaren . You can read more about presentations Brian is able to give in one or more 45-minutes sessions.

You’ll find more information on inviting Brian to speak here.
